resources.string: Pinned and recent apps first, a search, and Copy and Open
Shares from the keyboard and this app open it. Off uses Android\'s share sheet

The sheet lists every app that takes the share, the same apps Android\'s sheet lists. It shows no contacts, because only Android\'s own sheet can read those. More options on the sheet opens Android\'s sheet when you want them.
The apps you shared to last lead the sheet. Off forgets them
Drag to choose the order on the sheet
Hold an app on the sheet to pin it or take it off the recent row.
